items.exampleEn: He is qualified to drive a bus.
The actor recited his lines perfectly.
items.exampleZh: 那位演員把台詞背得一字不差。

items.exampleEn: Music is a nice complement to a good meal.
items.exampleZh: 音樂是美味一餐的絕佳搭配。

items.exampleEn: The nucleus is the center of an atom.
The library has a reading hour for preschool children.
items.exampleZh: 圖書館為學齡前兒童舉辦閱讀時間。

items.exampleEn: The examiner told us to put down our pens.
She wants to study genetics at university.
Check your spelling before you hand in your work.
items.exampleZh: 交作業前檢查一下拼字。

items.sentenceEn: My spelling has improved a lot this year.
items.sentenceZh: 我今年的拼字進步了很多。

items.audioEn: The examiner will check your ID before you enter the room.
items.audioZh: 主考官會在你進教室前檢查你的身分證。
items.questionZh: 進教室前會發生什麼事？
options: You will get a free pen and some paper.
Someone will look at your ID.
You will get a new ID.

items.sentenceEn: He can recite the whole poem from memory.
items.sentenceZh: 他能憑記憶背出整首詩。

items.sentenceEn: Genetics explains why children look like their parents.
items.sentenceZh: 遺傳學解釋了為什麼孩子長得像父母。

items.stemEn: Our math teacher will be the ____ for tomorrow's test.
items.stemZh: 我們的數學老師會是明天考試的主考官。

items.stemEn: To teach at this school, you must be ____ and have three years of experience.
items.stemZh: 要在這所學校教書，你必須具備資格，並且有三年經驗。

items.passageEn: Our school held a spelling contest last week. The examiner, a qualified teacher, read each word aloud. Some words came from science class, like "nucleus" and "genetics." I spelled "nucleus" correctly, but I made a mistake on "genetics." After the spelling part, each student had to recite a short poem. A preschool class came to watch, and the little kids cheered for everyone. The poem part was a nice complement to the spelling part, because it was more relaxing. I came in third, and I was satisfied.
items.passageZh: 我們學校上週舉辦了一場拼字比賽。主考官是一位合格的老師，他把每個字大聲唸出來。有些字來自自然課，像是「nucleus（原子核）」和「genetics（遺傳學）」。我拼對了 nucleus，但 genetics 拼錯了。拼字之後，每個學生都要背誦一首短詩。一個學齡前兒童的班級來觀賽，小朋友們為每個人加油。背詩的部分是拼字比賽很好的搭配，因為氣氛比較輕鬆。我得了第三名，覺得很滿意。

questions.questionZh: 拼字之後學生要做什麼？
options: 和幼兒班的小朋友玩遊戲

questions.questionZh: 為什麼背詩的部分是很好的搭配？
options: 因為小朋友很喜歡聽詩

items.promptZh: 她能背出全班同學的名字。
referenceEn: She can recite the names of all her classmates.
She is able to recite the names of all her classmates.
rubricZh: recite 表示「背誦、朗誦」，例如 recite the names… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 英文單字的拼法常常和讀音不一樣。
referenceEn: The spelling of English words is often different from how they sound.
English spelling often doesn't match how words sound.
rubricZh: 用 spelling 表示「拼字；拼法」
